skill.name: garbage-day
skill.description: 5374(ゴミナシ)形式の公開データと自治体公式のオープンデータで、ごみの収集日と品目別の分別・出し方を調べる。ごみの日、収集日、燃えるごみ、資源ごみの曜日、乾電池・スプレー缶など品目ごとの分別に対応。対象外の自治体や最新ルールの確証が必要な場合は、自治体の公式案内を案内する。
skill.summary: Look up Japanese municipal waste collection schedules and item disposal rules using public CSV datasets and official guidance.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: Of 53 static findings, 52 are false positives involving Markdown formatting, public HTTPS downloads, repository names, or a documentation link. The remaining finding confirms an HTTP fallback that exposes retrieved directory content to interception or modification. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, destructive commands, or data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: The regional directory fallback uses unencrypted HTTP because the skill reports a certificate mismatch.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the HTTP fallback with a verified HTTPS source or municipal guidance; do not bypass certificate checks.

content.user_title: Find Japanese Waste Collection Days and Sorting Rules
content.value_statement: Waste collection schedules and disposal rules differ across Japanese municipalities. This skill guides dataset lookups for local schedules and item classifications, with official-source referrals when information is missing.
actual_capabilities: Interpret weekly, monthly weekday, and explicit-date collection schedules from 5374 area_days.csv datasets.
Look up item classifications and disposal notices in municipality-specific target.csv tables.
Retrieve official item datasets for Tama and Yokohama, including CP932 conversion guidance for Yokohama.
List district names and offer partial-match candidates when district or item names are unclear.
Identify incomplete datasets and the Oita repository copy, then refer users to official municipal guidance.
Distinguish volunteer-maintained datasets from official sources and explain holiday or year-end uncertainty.
limitations: Coverage is limited; Bibai's documented item table contains only four entries.
Volunteer data can be outdated, and regular schedules alone do not establish holiday collection.
Live retrieval requires network access and suitable tools; the package contains instructions rather than bundled datasets or scripts.
The referenced shared response checklist is not included in the audited package.

use_cases.title: Check District Collection Days
use_cases.description: Find regular collection weekdays for a supported district and identify when official calendar confirmation is necessary.

use_cases.title: Verify Rules After Moving
use_cases.description: Check destination-city classifications for batteries and spray cans without assuming rules from the previous city.

use_cases.title: Answer Local Disposal Questions
use_cases.description: Find item notices, distinguish official and volunteer sources, and refer unresolved questions to municipal guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Regular Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Find regular burnable-waste collection days for Asanogawa district in Kanazawa. Identify the dataset and flag holiday uncertainty.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one district and one waste category

prompt_templates.title: Check an Item Classification
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official disposal instructions for dry-cell batteries in Yokohama. Preserve preparation notices and distinguish rechargeable batteries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: item lookup with safety notices

prompt_templates.title: Resolve an Unclear District Name
prompt_templates.prompt: Find collection data for [municipality] and list candidates matching [district fragment]. Ask me to confirm the district before giving its schedule.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Sources and Exceptions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare spray-can instructions for [city A] and [city B] using each city's current sources. Report source dates, missing information, and official confirmation needs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: municipality-specific comparison and source checks

output_examples.input: What regular collection days are documented for Asanogawa in Kanazawa?
output: The skill's September 2026 sample lists burnable waste on Mondays and Thursdays.
Nonburnable waste is listed for the fourth Wednesday; resources for the first, third, and fifth Tuesday.
Glass bottles are listed for the second Wednesday.
These are documented sample schedules, not a live verification; confirm holidays and current rules with the city.

output_examples.input: Can I use the listed Oita repository to check my collection day?
output: No. The skill documents that this repository still contains Kanazawa data rather than Oita collection information.
Use Oita's official collection calendar for your district instead.
Do not infer Oita collection days from the copied dataset.

output_examples.input: Does the documented Yokohama rule require puncturing spray cans?
output: The skill's documented Yokohama guidance says to use up the contents and not puncture spray cans.
Other municipalities have different instructions; do not transfer their rules to Yokohama.
Confirm the current instructions through Yokohama's official guidance before disposal.

best_practices: Confirm the municipality and district before interpreting a schedule or disposal category.
Inspect dataset headers, encoding, and source dates; preserve item-specific preparation notices.
Use verified HTTPS sources and prioritize current official guidance for holidays, rechargeable batteries, and safety-sensitive disposal.
anti_patterns: Applying one municipality's disposal rules to another municipality.
Treating volunteer datasets or documented sample dates as guaranteed current official guidance.
Guessing missing classifications, using copied Oita data, or trusting the HTTP fallback without independent verification.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Dataset retrieval requires network access and appropriate tools in the selected environment.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No. It uses publicly available CSV datasets and municipal pages without login or API keys.

faq.question: Which municipalities have documented collection datasets?
faq.answer: The skill lists Kanazawa, Bibai, Matsumae, Kasama, and Kamisunagawa. Tama and Yokohama provide documented official item datasets, not collection schedules here.

faq.question: Are all datasets official and current?
faq.answer: No. The 5374 datasets are volunteer-maintained. The skill documents September 2026 checks, but current availability and rules require verification.

faq.question: What happens when a district or item is missing?
faq.answer: The guidance checks name variants and offers candidates. If no reliable match exists, it refers users to official municipal information.

faq.question: What security concern was identified?
faq.answer: The directory fallback uses HTTP, allowing content interception or modification. Prefer verified HTTPS sources; the other static alerts were contextual false positives.
